params.title: Component parameters
params.description: Parameters of the factory:Factory component class - 'prescription', 'max_units'.

prescription.title: New Entity Prescription
prescription.description: Dictionary with prescription describing new entity. Refers to the entity body rather than the whole entity schema, because a prescription is not registered by alias and so needs no 'id' - ecs_manager reads entity_def.get('id', None) on this path.

max_units.title: Max Units
max_units.description: Number of units to be generated (optional, default None=unlimited).
